title: Tell Him How You Feel
story: Job Tells Heavenly Father His Feelings
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Job had so much inside his heart,
confused and sad and low;
He told Heavenly Father all,
he let his feelings show.

[Chorus]
You can tell Heavenly Father
the sad and happy too;
He always listens, always loves,
and gives His hope to you.

[Verse 2]
And even in his saddest time,
Job said, "I know one thing:
I know that my Redeemer lives,"
and hope began to sing.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and tell the Lord
the feelings in your heart;
He hears each word the whole night long,
you're never far apart.

[Chorus]
mood: Prayer music. A slow, even swing moves under the voice, like a child leaning against a parent's shoulder and telling everything that is inside. The first two verses hold that steady, listening sway, with room for sad words and hopeful ones. By the last verse the swing grows lower and slower, the last feeling spoken and the heart settled for sleep.
